summary: Platform-neutral Clash GUI components and injectable platform port contracts.
architecture_notes: components/ui/scroll-viewport.tsx adapts the pinned Microsoft Monaco DomScrollableElement. Read scroll-viewport.md before changing its private upstream import or scroll authority.
Components are pure React views driven by props or ports.
Runtime source must not call fetch, WebSocket, browser storage, Electron, local-api, filesystem APIs, or node:* modules.
Platform behavior belongs in apps/web adapters or apps/desktop controllers.

All inline, panel, and toast feedback uses components/ui/feedback.tsx with error, warning, info, or success semantics; products may compose branded artwork around panel feedback but must not fork colors, roles, or density behavior.
